Hello,

No problem. In case parts of the interview don't come through, I filled out
a Trustpilot review for $75 of a purchase of over $100. It told me to take
a screenshot of the review and email it to the address provided in the
offer. I did so but the email came back as undeliverable. How do I get the
$75 credit?

Tom

The $75 isn't something I can put on your account myself, so I've passed it to the team with your screenshot situation and order Shop···· noted. Sarah, HeliumDeploy
